# apps.apple.com chart page, recorded 14 Nov 2026

`us_7012.html`: `https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/charts/7012` (Puzzle, US storefront), the
radar's default Apple chart source, recorded once by hand on 14 Nov 2026 (~21:20 local time).
Minimised: only the `serialized-server-data` block is kept, and in it only the two chart
segments (Top Free Games, Top Paid Games) with each lockup's id, name, bundle id, subtitle and
rating count, and the ids of ranks 26-200 (`nextPage.remainingContent`). Public chart data.

`robots_apps.txt`: `https://apps.apple.com/robots.txt` as served the same day.
